::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 3. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 727
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](people/person_939.qmd) will see [Theuerdank](other_books/otherbook_419.qmd) somehow though I fear I shall not be at Oxford before I go to America on the 28th. The Bodleian dont let books out - in which they are quite right. Cambridge U.L. does - in which they are quite wrong, though I often benefit by it. I have written to Cambridge. When I see what the [pictures](organizations/other_167.qmd) look like I will be able to judge how the [book](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd) can be treated so as to have some novel effect.[^1]

ever faithfully yours
Alex Macmillan

---

[^1]: CMY had suggested that when *The Dove in the Eagle's Nest* was published in volume form it should be illustrated with pictures from *Der Theuerdank* (1517).
